description: This file contains a report script for 'Pending Sales Order Items for Purchase Request' in an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, fetch and process sales order and material request data, and handle product bundles and packed items.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes sales order and material request data to identify pending sales order items.

methods.name: get_items_with_product_bundle
methods.description: Retrieves item codes that are part of product bundles based on input list.

methods.name: get_packed_items
methods.description: Retrieves packed items related to sales orders and maps bundled items.
